name: blanka-mcp
description: Blanka (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, create_order. Every tool maps to a documented endpo

platform_mcp_blanka_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BLANKA_API_KEY
platform_mcp_blanka_api_key.description: Blanka API key (VIP membership; request it from the merchant success team, hello@blankabrand.com). Blanka's Postman reference sends it as the Authorization header value, exactly as issued.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe reads one catalogue row (GET /api/v1/products/?page_size=1 -> {count, next, previous, results[...]}).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /api/v1/products/?page=&page_size= (page_size has a server-side default and maximum): {count, next, previous, results[{id, name, sku, cost, suggested_cost (decimal strings, USD), available_inventory, weight, product_type (e.g. BLANK), image, categories[], description, benefits, ingredients, branded_box_available, is_expiring}]}. `cost`/`suggested_retail` are returned as the platform's decimal strings, so the numeric `price` is null; no filtering parameters are documented (query/category are ignored). Order by `sku`.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /api/v1/orders/ {order_id (your reference; a fresh UUID is sent), line_items, shipping_address}. Pass `items` as [{sku, quantity}] and `shipping_address` in Blanka's shape {first_name, last_name, company, address_1, address_2, city, state, postcode, country (ISO-2), phone}; both are sent as given. Returns 201 {id, order_id, status (e.g. PAYMENT_REQUIRED), tracking_code, line_items, shipping_address}; the order appears in https://app.blankabrand.com/orders/customer-orders.
